name: Ferrari
summary: Cinematic black automotive editorial style with full-bleed photography, small uppercase tracked type, zero-radius geometry, hairline dividers, and red reserved for interaction states.

typography.fallback: Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial Narrow, system-ui, sans-serif
traits: medium weight only for 16px section titles

layout.composition: full-bleed vertical scroll with centered single-column editorial rhythm

do: Use black and near-black full-width sections.
Use red only for interactive states or tiny signal accents.
Use uppercase, small, widely tracked interface type.
Use hairline dividers instead of shadows.
dont: Do not use red as a filled CTA background.
Do not add rounded cards or rounded buttons.
Do not add shadows, gradients, glow, or glass effects.
Do not frame or pad full-bleed hero photography.
Do not let the UI compete with the product image.
